issues.detail: The Hebrew 'אָשִׂים אֶת נַפְשְׁךָ' is first-person singular ('I will make your life'), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'ta không khiến mạng sống ngươi' with 'ta' (I) — this is correct. However, the Hebrew has no negation; the phrase is a positive oath 'I will make your life like the life of one of them.' The Vietnamese adds 'không' (not), reversing the meaning to 'if I do not make...' — this is a negation error.
